name: komnet-gateway
description: Connect Codex to a local komnet relay gateway through its portable request and reply queues.

interface.shortDescription: Use a local relay gateway from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Queue focused cross-team questions through a local komnet gateway and safely process attributed reply files. The gateway host remains a human-started Claude Code session; Codex uses the portable filesystem fallback.
defaultPrompt: Ask another team's agent through my local komnet gateway.
Check whether my komnet gateway has replies for this repository.
